questions.prompt: What is ready beside Luna's safe fire circle?
choices: a bucket of water and an extinguisher
a basket of berries and a blanket
a map and a magic wand
questions.answer: a bucket of water and an extinguisher
questions.evidenceText: A bucket of water and an extinguisher stood nearby.

questions.prompt: What did Glimmer do when Luna said, "Pause"?
questions.evidenceText: "Pause," said Luna. Glimmer stopped and waited.

questions.prompt: What does Glimmer learn about using their new fire?
choices: One careful flame can light many lamps.
A longer flame makes each lantern safer.
They must light every lamp alone.
questions.answer: One careful flame can light many lamps.
questions.rationale: Glimmer carefully lights one lantern, and its spark travels lamp by lamp along the paths; Luna's praise shows that one careful flame can light many lamps.
questions.evidenceText: "You made one careful flame," she said. "The lanterns carried the light."

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: Luna placed a magic lantern in the circle. "One small flame," she said. Glimmer lit it carefully.
The lantern sent a golden spark to the next lamp. Lamp by lamp, safe magical light travelled along the paths.
